source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.6, printed page 104.

blocks.text: Viscosity samajhne ke liye beaker mein pani ko sheeshe ki chhari se hilayein aur chhor dein; ghoomna kuch der baad tham jata hai. Ghaur se dekhein to deewaron ke saath wali liquid tah pehle rukti hai aur markaz ke qareeb wali tah sab se aakhir mein: deewaron ki sakin tah us se chhoone wali tah ko sust karti hai, woh sust tah agli androoni tah ko sust karti hai magar kam had tak, aur yun liquid ki sust chalti tah apne saath ki tez chalti tah ko sust karne ka rujhan rakhti hai. Yeh saath wali tahon ke darmiyan ragar (friction) ki quwwat hai.

blocks.title: Viscosity
blocks.text: Liquid ke behne mein yeh mazahmat viscosity kehlati hai. SI system mein is ki unit kg fi m fi s hai; CGS system mein unit poise (P) hai.

blocks.prompt: Hilaye hue beaker ke markaz ka liquid sab se der tak kyun chalta rehta hai?
blocks.explanation: Har tah apne bahar wali sust tah se ragar se sust hoti hai. Deewar wali tah deewar se foran ruk jati hai; agli tah us se sust hoti hai, aur yun andar tak, har tah bahar wali se thori kam raftar khoti hui. Markaz deewar se sab se door hai, to woh sab se aakhir mein aur sab se kam sust hota hai, aur us ki harkat sab se der tak rehti hai.

items: Viscosity liquid ki behne mein mazahmat hai, saath wali tahon ke darmiyan ragar ki quwwat (deewar wali tah pehle rukti hai, markaz aakhir mein); units kg fi m fi s (SI) ya poise (CGS).
